cues.text: In Paulownia Mall's Fountain Square, Chihiro walks a few steps ahead of you, then turns back to you, smiling.
She hurries off across the square toward a shop while you wait by a bench. Later, as she stands alone outside the shop, a young man in a jacket walks up and stops in front of her.
You walk over to them and face the man.
The man turns and walks off past you.
Chihiro, a hand raised to her mouth, runs off past you across the square.
